principles.name: Organize around user goals
principles.rule: Prioritize how users seek information and complete tasks, not only the organization's internal departments.

principles.name: Use clear navigation labels
principles.rule: Prefer familiar, descriptive labels over vague marketing terminology.

principles.name: Support distinct audiences
principles.rule: Provide audience-specific entry points when their tasks and information needs materially differ.

principles.name: Avoid unnecessary duplication
principles.rule: Reuse shared content rather than creating multiple competing versions without a clear need.

principles.name: Make critical information discoverable
principles.rule: Surface locations, contact methods, service eligibility, preparation information, and support where relevant.

principles.name: Separate public and private experiences
principles.rule: Public pages may link to authenticated portals, but must not expose restricted functionality or data.

principles.name: Preserve content relationships
principles.rule: During migration, maintain relevant connections among services, providers, locations, resources, and existing URLs.

process: Validate the sitemap against key journeys.

anti_patterns: Copying a competitor sitemap without validation
Creating pages solely to fill a template
Breaking existing URLs without a migration plan
